Resolves #3128

### Summary
- Extracts `Carousel` CSS variables (`--carousel-background-color`, `--carousel-duration`, `--carousel-inner-background-color`, `--carousel-inner-color`, `--carousel-transition-timing`, `--carousel-translate-x`, `--carousel-translate-y`) into `resources/scss/theme-{light,dark,neo-light,neo-dark,cyberpunk}/component/Carousel.scss`, using `:root .neo-theme-{light,dark,cyberpunk}` for classic/cyberpunk themes and `:where(.neo-theme-neo-{light,dark})` for neo themes (#18107) with variables-only declarations (#18145).
- Consolidates the two duplicate `.neo-carousel` structural blocks in `resources/scss/src/component/Carousel.scss` into one hierarchy consuming only `--carousel-*` tokens (removing foreign `--container-*` and `--button-*` dependencies).
- Adds `test/playwright/unit/component/CarouselThemeVars.spec.mjs` verifying token parity, selector weight, zero nested selectors across all five themes, and compiled SCSS cascade resolution for `neo-theme-cyberpunk` and `neo-theme-light`.

The head's light-theme positive control retains the transform and duration. This is a CSS/cascade witness, not a full application replay. The existing four-theme values and structural consolidation otherwise match the intended extraction; current-head CI is green.
